summary.en: This Week: how much you used AllInOneIME this week, kept only on this Mac. Shuangpin and Zhuyin, @question that keeps the conversation going (⏎ asks, ⇧⏎ inserts) and knows AllInOneIME's settings, clipboard history you can filter by typing, ← → pages in long lists, clearer panels, and icons and a test run for your own commands.
summary.zh: 本周统计：看这周用了多少 AllInOneIME，只存在这台 Mac 上。支持双拼和注音；@question 可以接着问（⏎ 追问，⇧⏎ 上屏），也懂 AllInOneIME 的设置；剪贴板历史打字就能筛选；长列表用 ← → 翻页；面板更清楚；自己的命令可以选图标、试运行。
